key_insight: ReTrace distills tool-using agents into reusable workflows where code selects each step, eliminating per-step LLM planning.
engineering_relevance: Repeated SOP execution can become faster and cheaper, with platform-independent rule documents compiled into platform-specific workflows.
method: Extract action conditions from an SOP and reasoning in a few logged agent runs.
Merge conditions across runs into a compact rule document and generate executable workflows.
Optionally repair workflows using labeled training failures.
evidence_signal: Across 79 production procedures, ReTrace achieved 93.8% completion versus the agent’s 96.8% at 24% lower cost; on τ²-Bench, it achieved 75.8% success versus 80.6% while running in 1.3 seconds versus 170 seconds.
watch_item: Unrepaired workflows can underperform agents or few-shot generation; reported repair gains rely on training failures, labeled for SOP-Bench.
paper_title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
